title.zh: Reason让Claude Code和Codex跨电脑派活：能互相对话，却还不能自动防代码冲突
title.en: Reason让Claude Code和Codex跨电脑派活：能互相对话，却还不能自动防代码冲突

current_state.zh: Reason launched Reason Network, a Rust-based cross-machine messaging layer that lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode agents delegate tasks and share live repository/branch state, though automatic detection of agents editing the same file is still unbuilt.
